text: Raw genius, shapeless marble and lumps of dye can become breathtaking works of art. The South has plenty of all of them.
A simple encampment with a well-visible "HYRING" sign is often enough to draw a conspicuous force of mercenaries that won't mind the spelling.
A larger recruitment building, compulsorily next to a tavern and reasonably close to a brothel, will draw more than the usual cutthroat.
Famed condottieri, adventuring knights, scarred veterans, exotic warriors, all in one well-organized and relatively peaceful hub.
With the promise of loot, professional soldiery is imported from the mainlands.
Inspired by the success of the colonies, major forces are made available from the homeland.
As the colony flourishes, entire powerful retinues are assembled, both local and imported.
Unknown tablets and mysterious stones are found in this region, for now unceremoniously sent to the homeland as proof of success.
Sizable amounts of artefacts are being found and smelt or otherwise traded home, for they are fetching a nice price.
Unknown tables and mysterious stones are found in this region... There is more in this than it catches the eye.
Invaluable artefacts are being recovered in the region, and traded to the neighbouring races for exorbitant rates.
The superhuman venture of cleansing the Skaven capital has begun. The surface is being purified by settlers, wizards and priests, but there is still fighting in the tunnels.
The disinfestation is proceeding, humans can call the settlement a livable town again, relatively free from Skaven presence.
The Doom of Kavzar is avenged! Tylos is reborn, a beacon of determination and wealth for all to see!
Restored and enlarged, Miragliano's channel system is a unique panorama of bridges and leaning towers, accurately safeguarded from infiltrating ratmen.
A respectful trading quarter, an expansion and improvement upon the existing Foreigners Quarter. Mutual benefits, at discreet rates.
Built upon the Sapphire Gate, this fortress makes sure there are more arbalests on the walls than resentful Elves inside.
Though incredibly expensive, this new type of bastion has no blind spots, is aesthetically pleasant, and is impervious to assaults and artillery. It may not be Shaggoth-proof.
While the Archecclesiatium is technically the governing council of Myrmidia's cult, it has become the main temple's name by association.

The ancient city of Luccini is built on elven ruins, but its temples are all too human. The Temple of Luccina is sacred to the city's peculiar rulers, and the Temple of Morr is one of the main chapterhouses for the god's knightly order.
Tobaro sits on rocks, most of them dangerous and many of them inhabited. The city has a history of Skaven infestations and invasions, which the scarred Deepwatch is trained to oppose.
Any small town may have a local farrier, but good weapon and armoursmiths tend to get reasonably wealthy where mercenaries come to buy and repair their gear.

With tricks of their own or dwarfen masters, southern smiths can produce quality gear and hallmark brass plate armour. Strong competition and high demand may drive to the creation of whole smithy districts and marketplaces.
The jungle can hide a lot of precious resources and fertile land. Plus, it's about time someone did something about the dog-sized mosquitoes.
High mountains are unforgiving and possibly host to several annoyed monsters. Human adaptability can take care of both.
Paid local militias can be given basic training, and all the clamour can attract better soldiers.
Citizens are rarely enthusiastic soldiers, but with enough effort they can be put into shape together with the local mercenary bands.
Given enough time and money, local militias and some of the reliable companies can be trained to work together.
Horses need tending, even for the lowliest local scout.
There is a good market for good steeds when good mounted companies are invited to work in the area. With good money.
Local nobles may own their own horses, but encouraging healthy manageries to tend and renew the stock is necessary.
Plenty of quality timber isn't just prettier firewood, and can be used for sturdier weapons and buildings.
There is an art in making full use of good trees.
Good iron ore is a precious commodity, propelling steel quality in the region.
Only premium steel here, for premium prices!
One can have the bare minimum, or try to improve upon it.
City barracks can put militias in shape, together with locally available mercenaries.

The best that a large city can offer locally, if the local Prince doesn't want to bother with too many mercenaries in the same place.

Southern mercenaries tend to be vastly more professional than their colleagues, and this city's infrastructure will attract legions of them.

Greenskin-afflicted villagers who dream of being saved by a swift ranger probably didn't imagine his breath and smell accurately enough.
The borderlands are dangerous places for dangerous men. Some of them are on the local prince's payroll.

Paying mercenaries to do your fighting is handy. However, you often end up paying more for them to stop fighting you.
Regiments and warbands that are normally kept in check are abundant and unruly, attracted by easy money and entertainment. The populace is definitely unhappy.
The province has seen better days, as entire armies of mercenaries obey their own whims and unscrupulous commanders more than any local Prince.
Just dropping the goods on the piers won't do. Having efficient storage in a strategic position is key to good commerce.

A small effigy of Myrmidia, that recruits and mercenaries pray and salute to.
This is essentially still Skavenblight, but with a beachhead on top. Skaven still lurk just outside of a cautious perimeter.
The Skaven are being pushed away and downwards, but danger is still very present. Some brave souls are starting to call the place home.
Ambitious pioneers are jump-starting the rebirth of a new and old city, and cleaning up the place from the everpresent rabbles and dead rats.
Against even the most optimistic predictions, business is booming! The swamp is being sanitised and you can almost not smell rat anymore!
For all the blood and sweat invested in it, the city is as powerful as any other human city-state, and a testament of determination. Now if only people could stop building towers.
Outposts from the Southern Realms are generally little more than bodyguards around a mercantile enterprise.
Tilea and Estalia have districts within the settlements of lands as far afield as Lustria, Ulthuan and even the Far East.
Strong embassies around the world guarantee the flow of commerce and mercenaries.
The many secrets of Ushoran still lie in these ruins, for those who can learn.
Mistakes were made. Mistakes will be repeated, because such is Fate.

Within these walls and halls, the garrison was inspired by the spirited Monna Lissa to defend the fabulous frescoes therein almost to the last man. True Tileans will die fighting rather than let anything happen to Tintoverdi's Five Seasons.
That big, ugly, mutated thing is a walking treasure hoard. Go on, shoot it down.
Norscan stone is filled with precious stuff that nobody claimed before, although some of the rocks fight back.
Vast empires are crude. Why bother micro-managing when you can direct subjects and allies from your seat of power?

The centre of Shallyan worship. Its magical waters are said to have been poured from the goddess's chalice, that which granted Ranald immortality, and which is perhaps even the Grail itself. Countless pilgrims travel here in the hopes of being cured of the deadliest afflictions.
One Mad Prince's folly to remove a Mad King's folly! The tyranny of windmills is over, leaving room for military drilling fields.
The success against the windmills, and the geography of the valley, make this just the perrrrrrfect spot for Lupio to leave his permanent mark. In gold.
With the Ratmen removed and the windmills restored, this valley can actually be of surprising effect.
